mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% relative to historical averages compresses discount rates, increasing equity valuations and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing liquidity and risk appetite to cause negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL indicate effective monetary easing without inflationary pressure, generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decline.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2% annualized), rising FEDFUNDS triggers tightening that causes negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the late-cycle regime condition.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1300 thousand indicates strong housing demand, signaling robust consumer confidence and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1300.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that may trigger inflation and rate hikes, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals strong manufacturing output, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS above 720,000 million dollars reflects elevated consumer spending, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns via sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 720000.
